title: TALK, LISTEN, CONNECT: HOW HUMANS AND AI EVALUATE EMPATHY IN RESPONSES TO EMOTIONALLY CHARGED NARRATIVES

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the impact of assigning a gender persona to the AI model on its empathy ratings, and using linear mixed models to test if perceived gender similarity to the storyteller influences empathy.
Using linear mixed models to measure whether perceived age similarity between the evaluator and the storyteller influences the level of evoked empathy.
Using linear mixed models to measure whether perceived racial similarity between the evaluator and the storyteller influences empathy ratings.

Comparing the model's empathy ratings on stories with positive versus negative emotional contexts to identify asymmetric responses, such as overemphasizing distress while under-responding to positive affect.
